title: Yellowed Crispy Italian Egg Plants Arancini
description: A fermented and springy solo dinner Italian dish featuring egg plants, cooked in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot, with a crispy exterior and a soft interior, dash friendly and formed into arancini balls.

ingredients.name: eggplant
ingredients.notes: preferably firm and heavy for the size

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the eggplants into 1 inch cubes and soak them in salt water for 30 minutes.
Drain the eggplant cubes and squeeze out excess moisture.
In a bowl, mix together the bread crumbs, parmesan cheese, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Dip each eggplant cube into the bread crumb mixture, coating it evenly.
Heat the olive oil in a ttukbaegi earthenware pot over medium heat and fry the eggplant cubes until golden brown.
In a separate bowl, mix together the tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, and chopped basil.
Stuff each fried eggplant cube with the tomato sauce mixture and shape into arancini balls.
Place the arancini balls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 15 minutes.
Serve the arancini hot and enjoy.
